entry.title: CBSE Holds Live Q&A Webinar on Registration and LOC for Board Examinations 2027 Webinar highlights CBSE’s focus on making examination-related processes more student-friendly and transparent
entry.summary: CBSE held a live Q&A webinar on 29 Sept 2026 about Registration and LOC for the 2027 board exams. Schools were urged to submit correct student details and subject combinations. The LOC process for Class X and XII has begun, and Registration for Classes IX and XI will start shortly.

entry.title: Press Release : CBSE Declares Class X Second Board Examination Results 2026
entry.summary: CBSE declared the Class X Second Board Examination results on 18 July 2026. Students can see them on DigiLocker (results.digilocker.gov.in). The overall pass percentage after combining the Main and Second exams is 96.78%.

entry.title: Verification of Issues Observed & Re-evaluation – Class XII Guidance for Students and Parents
entry.summary: FAQs for Class XII students and parents on Verification of Issues Observed and Re-evaluation. Revised results and marksheets come to DigiLocker. Marks can go up, go down or stay the same, because these are reviews and not automatic changes.

entry.title: Press Release : CBSE Commences Release of Class XII Verification of Issues observed and Re-evaluation Outcomes
entry.summary: Class XII Verification of Issues Observed and Re-evaluation results started appearing on DigiLocker from 21 June 2026, in phases. About 87% of applicants had results that day. Students whose result is No-change can inspect their answer book at a CBSE Regional Office; the schedule will be announced.
